stem.text: A microwave transmitter is placed at a fixed distance from a flat reflecting surface, as shown.

stem.text: A microwave detector is moved steadily in a straight line from X to Y. A series of maxima and minima of intensity is obtained. The distance between adjacent maxima is $1.5\,\text{cm}$.
